user.description:
Put your device into inclusion mode (refer to your device's manual if unsure how), then click **Next**.

**Note:** Devices included here are paired locally with the gateway and will not show up in the GARDENA app. If you wish to continue to use the app, include the device through the GARDENA app instead.
user.title: Include a GARDENA device

exclude_failed.description: Home Assistant removed the device, but the gateway did not confirm the exclusion, so the device may still be paired with the gateway. If it is, the device shows up in Home Assistant again the next time the gateway reports it. Remove it again while the gateway is online. To remove it without Home Assistant, reset the device as described in its manual.
exclude_failed.title: Could not remove {device_id} from the gateway
